The '''Shadow trooper gunship''' was a heavily modified [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]], utilized by [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence's]] [[Clone shadow trooper/Legends|clone shadow troopers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Due to shadow [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] typically operating in small numbers and their reliance on stealth, the standard [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] was rendered counterproductive to the stealth troopers. In cases where a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] shadow troopers needed to be dropped behind enemy lines, the Shadow trooper gunship was called in. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] featured a highly advanced [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]-[[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] package alongside specialized sensor-refractive [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating, which made it virtually invisible to all but visual scans. It was also equipped with a wide array of armaments, including [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] [[Missile/Legends|missiles]], [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]]. In addition, the gunship had markings which resembled the clone shadow trooper in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="Titanium" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shadow trooper gunship was created by [[Hasbro]] in [[2008]], for their [[Star Wars: Titanium Series|''Star Wars'': Titanium Series]] of die-cast vehicle models.<ref name="Titanium" />
